scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.format: prettier --write backend frontend/src frontend/*.js frontend/index.html tests scripts playwright.config.js package.json render.yaml README.md docs/*.md docs/submission.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check backend frontend/src frontend/*.js frontend/index.html tests scripts playwright.config.js package.json render.yaml README.md docs/*.md docs/submission.json
scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
